THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour which accompanies this order exists between.
Mrs. D.P.N.H. Mohotti, No. 32/2B, 7th Lane, Crow Island, Colombo 15. and
Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka, 354/2, 4th Floor, Nipunatha Piyasa, Elvitigala Mawatha, Narahenpita Colombo 05.

NOW THEREFORE I, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint. Mr. A.B. Herath 34/64, First Lane, Fort Macdowall Mawatha, Matale. to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
Dr. ANIL JAYANTHA FERNANDO, Minister of Labour.Colombo.25th March 2025,

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mrs. D.P.N.H. Mohotti, No. 32/2B, 7th Lane, Crow Island, Colombo 15. and
Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka, 354/2, 4th Floor, Nipunatha Piyasa, Elvitigala Mawatha, Colombo 05
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mrs. D.P.N.H. Mohotti working at the Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka in a Chief Management Assistant post has been caused injustice by the way in which the disciplinary inquiry against her was conducted and the disciplinary order dated 30.01.2020 and if so, to what relief she is entitled.
H.K.K.A. JAYASUNDARA, Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the ofﬁ ce of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, on this 27th day of February, 2025.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)

Mr. R.M. Wijeratne, No. 576/3, Subhasadaka Mawatha, Arawwala, Pannipitiya. and
Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd, No. 21, Vauxhall Street, Colombo 02.

NOW THEREFORE I, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint. Mr. H.R.L.Sugathadasa, No. 66/2A, Kohombanwattha, Galle. to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
Dr. ANIL JAYANTHA FERNANDO, Minister of Labour.
Colombo.25th March 2025,

Mr. R.M. Wijeratne, No. 576/3, Subhasadaka Mawatha, Arawwala, Pannipitiya. and
Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd, No. 21, Vauxhall Street, Colombo 02.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. R.M. Wijeratne who working as a Driver in the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd has been caused injustice by the method followed to calculate overtime prior to 2015 being amended after 2015 and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
H.K.K.A. JAYASUNDARA, Commissioner General of Labour.
